name: Paper & Bloom
tagline: Kraft-and-petal florist with a parallax bouquet
description: A fresh-cut editorial build for a Savannah florist — a three-layer SVG bouquet tilting in real depth under drifting petals, with arrangement cards that lean toward the cursor and weekly subscription tiers priced to order.

name: Oakline
tagline: Furniture workshop with a CSS-built turntable credenza
description: Workshop warmth for a Hudson furniture studio — a white-oak credenza composed from lit CSS planes revolving on its plinth, material swatches that flip in 3D to their specs, and a collection priced with dimensions in mono.

name: The Novel House
tagline: Lamp-lit bookshop with an opening 3D book hero
description: Library dusk for a Burlington bookshop and café — a CSS-plane book whose cover breathes open under a brass lamp of canvas dust motes, staff-pick cards with page-edge detail, and an author-night calendar with real dates.
